_migration_metadata.description: Customer CDC pipeline — snapshot → detect changes → apply → audit
migration_notes: 4 sequential air_run steps mapped to 4 Databricks tasks with depends_on
AutoSys 4-hour schedule mapped to Quartz cron: 0 0 0/4 * * ?
Steps 1+2 (snapshot + detect) collapsed into single MERGE in Databricks
Step 3 (apply) is implicit in the MERGE — no separate apply phase needed
Step 4 (audit) mapped to CDF + audit notebook for change tracking
8 partitions (-partition 8) handled by Spark native partitioning
HASH_COLUMNS from customer_cdc.pset mapped to CDC compare_columns widget

name: customer_cdc_pipeline
description: Customer CDC pipeline (every 4 hours) — migrated from Ab Initio run_customer_cdc.ksh (AutoSys: JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC)

schedule._migration_note: AutoSys JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC ran every 4 hours. Quartz cron: 0 0 0/4 * * ? = at minute 0 past every 4th hour. Set pause_status to UNPAUSED when ready.

new_cluster._migration_note: Ab Initio used -partition 8 for CDC detection. shuffle.partitions=16 provides comparable parallelism. Adjust num_workers based on customer table size.

parameters.name: environment
parameters._migration_note: Replaces PSET environment resolution. Controls schema names.

parameters.name: compare_columns
parameters._migration_note: customer_cdc.pset → HASH_COLUMNS minus KEY_COLUMNS. In Ab Initio these were MD5-hashed; in Delta MERGE they are compared directly.

parameters.name: retention_days
parameters._migration_note: customer_cdc.pset → RETENTION_DAYS (90). Used for Delta table history retention.

tasks.description: Step 1: Snapshot current customer state from source — replaces air sandbox run snapshot_customer.mp

_pset_mapping.target_table: Maps to CURRENT_SNAPSHOT_PATH (/data/snapshots/customer/current) as a Delta table

tasks._migration_note: KornShell Step 1: air sandbox run snapshot_customer.mp. In Ab Initio, this wrote a flat-file snapshot. In Databricks, we write to a Delta table (customer_snapshot) which serves as the MERGE source.

tasks.description: Steps 2+3: CDC detection and apply — replaces cdc_detect_customer.mp + apply_customer_changes.mp. Delta MERGE does both in one atomic operation.

_pset_mapping.compare_columns: customer_cdc.pset → HASH_COLUMNS minus KEY_COLUMNS. No longer hashed — direct column comparison.
_pset_mapping.enable_cdf: New: Change Data Feed replaces CDC_OUTPUT_PATH flat files
_pset_mapping.handle_deletes: Ab Initio CDCProcessor always detected deletes

tasks._migration_note: Consolidates KornShell Steps 2 + 3. In Ab Initio, Step 2 (cdc_detect) produced separate INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE files, then Step 3 (apply_changes) loaded them. Delta MERGE does detection + apply atomically in one statement.

tasks.description: Step 4: Generate audit trail from CDF — replaces air sandbox run audit_customer_changes.mp

_pset_mapping.source_table: Reads CDF from customer_master (replaces CDC_OUTPUT_PATH flat files)

tasks._migration_note: KornShell Step 4: audit_customer_changes.mp. In Ab Initio, this read CDC output files. In Databricks, it reads Change Data Feed (CDF) from the customer_master Delta table. The cdc_audit notebook (to be implemented) uses CDCProcessor.read_changes() to query CDF and write to the audit table.

email_notifications._migration_note: Add team email addresses. Replaces AutoSys job notifications.

webhook_notifications._migration_note: Add Slack/PagerDuty webhook URLs. Replaces monitoring/job_monitor.py alerts.
